text.tspan: App launch — SplashScreen (2 s, silent update check)
full name · email · phone (optional) · birthday (13+, required)
no session · no profiles row yet
profiles row INSERT · RLS: auth.uid() = id
clear pending · set user + profile · login hook
12 s timeout, cached per user id
(a late provider profile can still rescue it)
ActiveTab publishes the visible tab index
Labels in SoleBottomNav for roleCustomer: Home · Store · Notifications · Profile.
A brand-new customer signup skips every gate in layer 1: no MFA factor is enrolled yet, the device
was recorded as trusted by _finishSignupSession(), and role = customer falls through to the final
else branch of _routeByRole — so it lands straight on this shell.
